guidance.bestFor: A single unchecked box tied to its label through id and htmlFor, with no helper copy below
A box that starts ticked and cannot be toggled, with its whole Field flagged disabled
An error state driven by aria-invalid on the box and data-invalid on the Field around it
agentNotes: `aria-invalid` on the `Checkbox` and `data-invalid` on the `Field` are hardcoded; drive both from your validation result

guidance.bestFor: A box held in the mixed state that a parent shows when only some of its children are ticked
agentNotes: `indeterminate` is a fixed prop here; compute it from how many child boxes are ticked, as `c-checkbox-16` does

whenNotToUse.when: A parent box that has to follow real child boxes as they change

guidance.bestFor: A consent line such as accepting terms, ticked by default, with helper copy under the label
agentNotes: `defaultChecked` starts the terms box ticked; drop it so people opt in themselves before you record consent

guidance.bestFor: Ticked boxes recolored blue, green and yellow with data-checked fill and border classes in both themes
A round box whose label dims and gets struck through once ticked, like a done item in a to-do list
A titled stack of 3 notification channels, each row its own box and label, 2 of them ticked
agentNotes: The group heading is a `FieldLabel` with no `htmlFor`, so it names no control; wrap the 3 rows in a fieldset with a legend

guidance.bestFor: One bordered card, clickable anywhere, that pairs a setting title with a line of helper copy

whenNotToUse.when: A single setting that takes effect at once with no save step

guidance.bestFor: Notification rows inside the ReUI Frame primitive, a titled header over a panel split by separators
A plain Card of 3 full width rows split by separators, each whole row toggling its leading box
Card rows that lead with a muted channel icon and push the box to the trailing edge
A row of 3 compact title tiles, each with a round borderless check overhanging its top right corner
A 2 column grid of module tiles with an icon chip, title and description, and a round box inset top right
agentNotes: `items` holds the 4 tiles, their icons and starting `checked` flags; map your own modules into it

guidance.bestFor: A person card with avatar, name and handle, the box sitting at its trailing edge
agentNotes: `AvatarImage` loads a remote Unsplash photo of a sample person; point it at your user's avatar and put their initials in `AvatarFallback`

whenNotToUse.when: Picking exactly 1 person, such as a single assignee or owner

guidance.bestFor: A 3 level permission tree where a parent ticks or clears every leaf below and shows a mixed state when only some are on
agentNotes: `data` is the sample permission tree and `checked` seeds 3 ticked leaves; replace both with your own roles and grants
Only leaf ids are stored in `checked`; parent state is derived through `getLeafIds`, so persist leaves only

whenNotToUse.when: A hierarchy deep enough to need branches that expand and collapse

guidance.bestFor: A saved card tile with a brand mark, masked number and expiry, ticked by a round box in its corner
agentNotes: `MastercardIcon` is an inline brand SVG and the card number and expiry are hardcoded strings; render them from the saved card

whenNotToUse.when: Choosing the 1 card a payment is charged to

name: c-checkbox-18
title: Checkbox with label and tooltip info
label: Help Icon Tooltip
description: Checkbox with label and tooltip info

guidance.bestFor: An opt-in whose label ends in a help icon that opens a tooltip on the right with the longer explanation
agentNotes: `TooltipTrigger` wraps only an `aria-hidden` icon, so the help button has no accessible name; give it a label

guidance.bestFor: Feature opt-ins tagged with the ReUI Badge at its sm size, a default New pill and a secondary Beta pill
agentNotes: `defaultChecked` sits on the second `Field`, not its `Checkbox`, so Beta feature access renders unticked; move it onto the box

name: c-checkbox-20
title: Checkbox with label and tooltip info
label: Right Side Tooltip
description: Checkbox with label and tooltip info

guidance.bestFor: An exact duplicate of c-checkbox-18, sharing its tooltip-checkbox id, label text and right side tooltip
agentNotes: The help button from `TooltipTrigger` is announced without a name because its icon is `aria-hidden`; add an accessible label
The `tooltip-checkbox` id repeats in `c-checkbox-18`, so rename it when both render on the same page

guidance.bestFor: Short options such as Read, Write and Delete set side by side in a row that wraps on narrow screens
Feature flags tagged with the stock Badge shrunk by hand to an 18px pill of 10px uppercase text with wide tracking

whenNotToUse.when: Pills sized by a prop rather than hand set height and text classes
